cohort_coverage.selection_definition: The six APT cases listed in Table 4; the source states six APT animals were analyzed.

declarations.note: Source-table listing count; not a disposition partition.

limitations: This is a candidate transcription of selected per-case body-weight, support-duration, adverse-status, and disposition summaries; it is not the article's raw time-series dataset.
Source case labels A-F are not external persistent identifiers; gestational start day is not mapped to an individual case.

developmental_interval records each case's full reported support episode; observation.measurement_time locates a table value within that episode. Induction body weight is at 0 hours, while conclusion weight is at the case-reported duration.
Terminal growth, organ, biochemical, and cardiac endpoints are reported as group summaries in Tables 1, 3, and 6; no per-case join to these endpoints is published.
The abstract reports six age-matched in-utero controls while Methods and endpoint tables report eight; this candidate contains no control observations or case-to-control links.
The article reports no post-support developmental follow-up. No growth rate, effect estimate, or biological fit is calculated here.
Bleeding and edema entries preserve exact source-coded status/time strings; event timing is not parsed or inferred.
Case narratives describe per-case events and endpoint timing, but the two aggregate umbilical-artery-vasoconstriction dispositions are not explicitly assigned to case labels A-F.
